author: Leon Made This / s010s

originality.en: Entirely original procedural mesh design; no third-party model, texture or palette assets.
originality.zh: 全部为原创参数化几何；未使用第三方模型、纹理或下载色板。

scientific_scope.en: Evidence-informed stylized plant concept, not a taxon or site reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 有依据的风格化植物概念，并非具体物种或化石地点复原。

modeling_runtime: GPT-6 Astra; xhigh; Blender 4.3.2; cloud only

topology_notes.en: Leaves are closed folded blades with a slight ridge and real thickness. No alpha cards. Separate semantic fronds remain editable.
topology_notes.zh: 叶片均为具浅脊线与真实厚度的闭合折面实体；不使用透明贴片。语义分组叶片可分别编辑。

scale_note.en: Dimensions are artistic asset specifications in meters, not measured fossil dimensions.
scale_note.zh: 米制尺寸为美术资产规格，不是化石测量值。

sources.title: NHM: Unfurl the secrets of ferns

design_parameters.silhouette_signature: ground-level crown; three frond heights; bowed drooping pinnae; one unfurling crozier

reconstruction_notes.en: A generalized Mesozoic fern-form concept. The simplified pinnae, growth stage and color are artistic choices; it is not an identification of a living fern species, seed fern, or fossil specimen. Reproduces no flowers or seed clusters.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 宽泛的中生代蕨形概念。简化羽片、生长阶段及配色为美术选择；不是现生蕨种、种子蕨或某件化石标本的鉴定。不制作花或种子串。

description.en: Seven soft arching fronds with staggered, folded pinnae and an exposed young fiddlehead.
description.zh: 七片柔曲拱形叶轴带交错宽羽片，近地叶丛外缘下垂，并保留一片清楚的新卷芽。
